tools.name: estimate_automation_savings
tools.description: Estimate monthly and annual time savings and JPY equivalents from task assumptions; rank tasks by time saved. Estimates do not guarantee outcomes. 業務ごとの前提から削減時間と円換算を試算します。

tools.name: draft_automation_spec
tools.description: Draft a ten-section automation specification from existing steps, marking human approval gates and automation candidates. No actions are executed. 現行手順から承認箇所を明示した仕様書の下書きを作成します。

tools.name: check_japanese_ad_copy
tools.description: Mechanically flag potentially misleading Japanese advertising claims with severity, quoted context, and alternative wording. This is not a legal determination. 日本向け広告・LPの表現を機械的に点検します。
